_comment: Authored difficulty per change-detection pair, matching the tiers assigned in BRIEF.md. Read by scripts/build_change_manifest.py, which stamps it into the generated manifest. Difficulty is an ATTENTION property, not a size one: changes to the subject are found fast, changes to background or incidental objects are much harder even when large, and changes inside a repeating pattern are hardest of all. Keys not listed here ingest as NULL (treated as medium).
